title: InnerLogic-Surg: An Open Surgical Foundation Model via Continual Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.07883v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision foundation models are the backbone of modern surgical image analysis, yet most surgical systems still rely on encoders pretrained on natural images or on specialist models trained from scratch on comparatively small datasets. Pretraining encoders on large amounts of surgery-specific data has the potential to generally enhance the performance of surgical image analysis methods simply by providing stronger backbones. Here we present InnerLogic-Surg, an open family of surgical vision encoders (21M--300M parameters) obtained by continually pretraining a transformer-based image encoder on millions of surgical images curated from 11,965 internet-sourced surgical videos spanning ~2,900 hours and more than fifteen procedure types. Our training recipe inherits DINOv3's pretraining stage to preserve representation ability after surgical adaptation, and additionally applies a learned feature-upsampling module for high-resolution dense pred

translated_title: InnerLogic-Surg：通过持续预训练构建的开放式手术基础模型
translated_abstract: 视觉基础模型是现代手术图像分析的支柱，然而大多数手术系统仍然依赖于在自然图像上预训练的编码器，或者依赖于在相对较小的数据集上从头训练的专用模型。在大量手术特定数据上预训练编码器，有可能仅通过提供更强的骨干网络就能普遍提升手术图像分析方法的性能。在此，我们提出InnerLogic-Surg，一个开放的手术视觉编码器家族（参数量从2100万到3亿），它通过对基于Transformer的图像编码器进行持续预训练而获得，训练数据是从11,965个互联网来源的手术视频中精选的数百万张手术图像，涵盖约2,900小时、超过十五种手术类型。我们的训练方案继承了DINOv3的预训练阶段，以便在手术领域适配后保持其表征能力，并额外应用了一个可学习的特征上采样模块，用于高分辨率密集预测任务。
tldr: 本文提出InnerLogic-Surg，一个基于DINOv3持续预训练、利用来自11,965个手术视频约2,900小时的数百万张图像训练而成的开放式手术视觉基础模型家族（21M-300M参数），可显著增强手术图像分析任务的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces InnerLogic-Surg, an open family of surgical vision foundation models (21M-300M parameters) built via continual pretraining of DINOv3 on millions of surgical images from ~2,900 hours across 11,965 surgical videos, providing stronger backbones that generally enhance surgical image analysis performance.
